segments.say: [Loopback](/lˈupbˌæk/) Transformer. Towards a unified view of residual looped transformers.
segments.display: Loopback Transformer: Towards a Unified View of Residual Looped Transformers.

segments.say: Linear attention is a memory over tokens. Each token writes its key and value into a state that is passed along, and later tokens read from it. The residual stream does the same over depth. Each block writes its update into the stream, which carries it forward to the blocks that read from it later. Unrolled, every read is a weighted sum of what was written, and the standard residual fixes every weight at one.
segments.display: Linear attention is a memory over tokens. Each token writes its key and value into a state that is passed along, and later tokens read from it. The residual stream does the same over depth. Each block writes its update into the stream, which carries it forward to the blocks that read from it later. Unrolled, every read is a weighted sum of what was written, and the standard residual fixes every weight at one.

segments.say: Every residual rule fits one interface. It carries a memory forward, writes each block's result into it, and reads the next input from it. The standard residual keeps one stream and adds every update with weight one. Hyper Connections keep several streams and learn how to mix, write, and read them. Attention Residuals store each update in its own slot and read them with one softmax. Unrolled, every rule sets the strength of the input, the total weight of the updates, and the share of each update.
segments.display: Every residual rule fits one interface. It carries a memory forward, writes each block's result into it, and reads the next input from it. The standard residual keeps one stream and adds every update with weight one. Hyper-Connections keep several streams and learn how to mix, write, and read them. Attention Residuals store each update in its own slot and read them with one softmax. Unrolled, every rule sets the strength of the input, the total weight of the updates, and the share of each update.

segments.say: [Loopback](/lˈupbˌæk/) sets the three separately. The input keeps a weight of one on its own path, so the stack still returns its input when the updates vanish. A decay bounds the total, and attention shares it across the stored updates.
segments.display: Loopback sets the three separately. The input keeps a weight of one on its own path, so the stack still returns its input when the updates vanish. A decay bounds the total, and attention shares it across the stored updates.

segments.say: Here are our training curves at all five scales. [Loopback's](/lˈupbˌæks/) loss is lower from early in training all the way to the end.
segments.display: Here are our training curves at all five scales. Loopback's loss is lower from early in training all the way to the end.

segments.say: From one hundred ninety-one million to three billion parameters, [Loopback](/lˈupbˌæk/) reaches lower loss than the standard transformer while using only forty to seventy-five percent of its parameters.
segments.display: From 191M to 3B parameters, Loopback reaches lower loss than the standard Transformer while using only 40–75% of its parameters.

segments.say: At all three sizes we tested, it has the lowest loss and the highest benchmark average of all nine designs.
segments.display: At all three sizes we tested, it has the lowest loss and the highest benchmark average of all nine designs.

segments.say: We also held the parameter count fixed and traded width for depth. As the model gets deeper and narrower, the standard transformer loses ground, while [Loopback's](/lˈupbˌæks/) margin grows at both scales.
segments.display: We also held the parameter count fixed and traded width for depth. As the model gets deeper and narrower, the standard Transformer loses ground, while Loopback's margin grows at both scales.

segments.say: That's [Loopback](/lˈupbˌæk/). Fewer parameters, lower loss. The paper and code are on our project page.
